name: M5.Translation.shift_card_anchor
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset (ZMod N)) (c : ZMod N), c ∈ S → (M5.Translation.shift S (-c)).card = S.card ∧ 0 ∈ M5.Translation.shift S (-c)
queries: ZMod val add sub modulo injective
guidance:
Addition by a fixed group element is injective, so Finset.card_image_iff gives the cardinality. The chosen c maps to c-c=0. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
